title: 8 Signs You Don't Have the Godly Brothers You Think You Do
caption:
8 signs you don't have the godly brothers you think you do. A group chat isn't a covenant.

Nobody's texted you first in a month. They only hear from you when you're doing well. You've never told any of them your actual sin, and they'd be surprised to hear you're struggling. Nobody's ever called you out and meant it, and you've never prayed with them out loud.

Real brothers would ask questions if you disappeared. Count how many actually would.
